hero.eyebrow: Taxi in Lille and the surrounding area
hero.title: Your taxi in Lille, simply.
hero.subtitle: Stations, airports or long distances: describe your trip and receive a personalised reply.

hero.cardNote: Two pieces of information are enough to start: your journey and your phone number.

services.title: Three ways to travel with us
services.intro: Every trip is quoted to measure: we start from your address, your schedule and your constraints to give you a clear price.

how.title: Three steps, no more
how.intro: No automatic booking: every request is checked and confirmed by the operator.
how.step1Body: Addresses, date, time, number of passengers and any constraints, through the quote form.
how.step2Body: It is saved with a unique reference. You can call us or message us on WhatsApp at any time.
how.step3Body: We give you the price, the agreed time and the payment method before any commitment.
how.disclaimer: Submitting this form confirms no journey: the price and the time are validated with you.

why.title: A service you can understand, start to finish
why.intro: We prefer clear commitments to vague promises.
why.item1Body: Every request is read and handled by the operator, with a clear price.
why.item2Body: No amount is requested before you explicitly agree.
why.item3Body: The pick-up time is confirmed with you before departure.
why.item4Body: Luggage, child seat, pets: your constraints are taken into account from the outset.
why.item5Body: Phone and WhatsApp: you speak to the operator directly, with no intermediary.
why.item6Body: Your contact details and your journey are used only to organise your trip.

area.title: Lille and its surrounding area
area.body: We mainly operate in Lille and the immediate surrounding area. Give us your pick-up address and destination: we will confirm ourselves whether the trip is possible.
area.note: The list of covered towns changes over time — get in touch to check your address.

overview.title: Our taxi services
overview.intro: Taxi Nord Lille operates three types of journeys. In every case the price is worked out to measure after reviewing your request.
overview.gareInfo: Exact station address to be confirmed
overview.longueInfo: Price set after reviewing the trip
overview.ctaBody: Describe your trip and we will tell you which service is most suitable.

gare.name: Station taxi
gare.tagline: Arrivals and departures by train in Lille
gare.short: Transfers to and from Lille railway stations.
gare.intro: Getting off a train with a pile of luggage or a connection to catch? We take care of your journey to your hotel, your home, your office or the next step of your trip.
gare.stationsIntro: State the station and the direction of the trip in your request: we confirm the exact meeting point before departure.
gare.step1Body: Lille-Flandres, Lille-Europe or another station in the region.
gare.step2Body: Include the train number and arrival time so we can set the pick-up time accordingly.
gare.step3Body: We come back to you with the price and the pick-up time.
gare.tip1Body: Let us know as soon as you can: we adjust the pick-up time at no extra cost.
gare.tip2Body: Mention the number and size of bags in your request so we can allocate a suitable vehicle.
gare.tip3Body: Simply state the exact time: we confirm feasibility in our reply.
gare.ctaBody: The form is already pre-filled with the "Station taxi" service.

aeroport.name: Airport transfer
aeroport.short: Transfers to and from Lille-Lesquin airport.
aeroport.intro: An early-morning flight, a tight connection, cases to carry: an airport transfer takes planning. We prepare your trip in advance and set the price before departure.
aeroport.airportsIntro: Lille-Lesquin airport is our main destination. Other airports can be considered: mention them in your request.
aeroport.lilleLesquinBody: The main airport serving Lille, roughly 15 minutes by car from the city centre, depending on traffic.
aeroport.otherAirportsBody: Paris-Charles-de-Gaulle, Paris-Orly, Brussels, Amsterdam… State the airport in your request and we will confirm whether we can cover it.
aeroport.step1Body: The earlier you ask, the more room we have to prepare a suitable vehicle.
aeroport.step2Body: The flight number helps us size the trip. This is not automatic flight tracking.
aeroport.step3Body: We agree the exact pick-up point, terminal or entrance, and the time.
aeroport.tip1Title: We do not track your flight
aeroport.tip1Body: We do not use live flight tracking. This is why we ask you to tell us about delays: the time is adjusted with you.
aeroport.tip2Body: The transfer is calculated from when you leave the aircraft and clear baggage, not from the scheduled departure.
aeroport.tip3Body: The number of passengers and bags determines the vehicle we propose, so we need it in your request.
aeroport.ctaBody: The form is already pre-filled with the "Airport transfer" service.

longe.name: Long-distance journeys
longe.short: Trips to other cities and regions.
longe.intro: A business trip, a house move, a TGV station on your doorstep: we organise journeys that go beyond the daily routine of Lille.
longe.destinationsIntro: Here are a few trips we are often asked about. The list is not exhaustive: any destination can be considered on a case-by-case basis.
longe.dest1Body: Paris stations, offices, hotels and airports.
longe.dest2Body: Regional trips to the towns of Hauts-de-France.
longe.dest4Body: Weekends and holidays on the coast.
longe.step1Body: Addresses, date, time, number of passengers and constraints.
longe.step2Body: Distance, estimated duration and vehicle constraints.
longe.step3Body: A clear, final price, to be accepted before anything is organised.
longe.tip1Body: We do not calculate prices online. The quote is prepared once we receive your request.
longe.tip2Body: Beyond a certain radius we look into a relay with another operator. You are informed of it.
longe.tip3Body: Describe the whole stay and we will propose a suitable arrangement.
longe.ctaBody: The form is already pre-filled with the "Long-distance journeys" service.
